                The owner's salutation, formed as 'title lastName' when a title
                is present (e.g. 'DR Who'), or just the lastName when no title
                was supplied.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'DR Franklin'
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone (display)
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the '+' and
                country calling code, a space, then the national digits grouped
                in threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' remains
                in E.164 form.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: >-
                The owner's unified member identifier, formatted
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>': the region code, the 2-digit fiscal
                year (see 'fiscalYear'), the 8 upper-case hex HASH8 (the first 8
                hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone plus last
                name), and a single Luhn check digit CHK computed over the digits
                of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. When the computed value collides with an
                existing owner's, a '-<n>' suffix (smallest n of 2 or more) is
                appended to keep it unique.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'NSW261A2B3C4D9'
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners who share a household (same
                last name and postcode). Computed deterministically as the first
                12 hex characters of SHA-256 over (normalized last name + '|' +
                postcode), so owners in the same household share the same value.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) that
                shared the same first name and last name, compared
                case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 1
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last
                two digits of the fiscal year's starting calendar year. The
                fiscal year starts on 1 July, so a business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate on or after 1 July belongs to that calendar
                year's fiscal year and one before 1 July belongs to the previous
                calendar year's fiscal year. Absent when no registrationDate is
                available.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'FY26'
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points. Starts at 0; add 2 when an email
                address is present; add 1 when the owner has no namesakes
                (namesakeCount is 0); add 2 for a household of 3 or more; add 3
                for tenure of at least one elapsed fiscal year, measured as the
                number of fiscal-year starts (1 July) between the
                registrationDate and the current date.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 5
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, derived from
                membershipPoints: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3 points, 3 for 4-5
                points, and 4 for 6 or more points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              readOnly: true
              example: 3
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality: the canonical region derived from the city
                using the fixed city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'NSW'
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name, derived from the locality using
                the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when
                the locality is not in the table.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created for this
                owner's registration date at the time this owner was created,
                otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when this owner's city already held between 40 and 49
                owners (approaching the per-city capacity limit of 50) at the
                time this owner was created, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email
                address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'EMAIL'
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, although not a hard duplicate, shares an
                existing owner's last name and postcode while carrying a
                different telephone; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner is a possible duplicate
                of (same last name and postcode, different telephone). Absent
                when 'possibleDuplicate' is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 1
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived identity key, formed as
                'normalizedTelephone + | + (email or empty) + | + householdId'.
                This single key consolidates all duplicate detection: a new owner
                is rejected with 409 only when its whole identityKey exactly
                matches an existing owner's.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '+61412345678||A1B2C3D4E5F6'
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from 'birthDate' evaluated against
                the owner's registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when
                18 to 64, and 'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Absent when no birthDate
                was supplied.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'ADULT'
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical URI path of this owner, formed as '/api/owners/'
                followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '/api/owners/1'
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM'
                when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is
                'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD),
                otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                True when any of these hold: the owner is a possible duplicate
                ('possibleDuplicate'), the owner's email domain is
                disposable-adjacent (it resembles a throwaway/disposable mailbox
                provider without being on the hard disposable blocklist, which is
                rejected outright), or the owner's city is over its soft capacity
                (the per-city capacity warning applies, i.e. the city already held
                40 or more owners). Otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is
                false; DELETE /api/owners/{id} marks the owner deleted (true) while
                retaining the record. Owners flagged deleted are ignored by the
                create endpoint's duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - deleted
            - pets

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The pet owner's optional honorific title (e.g. MR, MRS, MS, DR).
            When present it drives the derived 'salutation'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 30
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat value for
            backward compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2'
            fields are supplied they are preferred. On a response this is the
            composed, normalized address (the normalized 'addressLine1', with a
            single space and the normalized 'addressLine2' appended when present).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured postal address. Preferred
            over the flat 'address' when present; normalized like the flat address.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address.
            When present it is normalized and appended to the composed 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized by
            removing every non-digit character and must contain exactly 10 digits
            after stripping.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; validated only when present.
            When supplied it must be valid for the owner's city per the fixed
            region ranges (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city
            with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned
            when given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD). Optional;
            when present it drives the derived 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allow creating this owner even though another owner
            already has the same last name and postcode (i.e. they share a
            household); the owner is then created as a declared household member
            rather than rejected as a household duplicate, and is not flagged as
            a possible duplicate. Write-only; never returned in responses.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the stored
                names.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'Franklin, George'
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'G.F.'
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, formed as 'title lastName' when a title
                is present (e.g. 'DR Who'), or just the lastName when no title
                was supplied.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'DR Franklin'
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone (display)
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the '+' and
                country calling code, a space, then the national digits grouped
                in threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' remains
                in E.164 form.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: >-
                The owner's unified member identifier, formatted
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>': the region code, the 2-digit fiscal
                year (see 'fiscalYear'), the 8 upper-case hex HASH8 (the first 8
                hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone plus last
                name), and a single Luhn check digit CHK computed over the digits
                of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. When the computed value collides with an
                existing owner's, a '-<n>' suffix (smallest n of 2 or more) is
                appended to keep it unique.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'NSW261A2B3C4D9'
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners who share a household (same
                last name and postcode). Computed deterministically as the first
                12 hex characters of SHA-256 over (normalized last name + '|' +
                postcode), so owners in the same household share the same value.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) that
                shared the same first name and last name, compared
                case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 1
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last
                two digits of the fiscal year's starting calendar year. The
                fiscal year starts on 1 July, so a business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate on or after 1 July belongs to that calendar
                year's fiscal year and one before 1 July belongs to the previous
                calendar year's fiscal year. Absent when no registrationDate is
                available.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'FY26'
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points. Starts at 0; add 2 when an email
                address is present; add 1 when the owner has no namesakes
                (namesakeCount is 0); add 2 for a household of 3 or more; add 3
                for tenure of at least one elapsed fiscal year, measured as the
                number of fiscal-year starts (1 July) between the
                registrationDate and the current date.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 5
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, derived from
                membershipPoints: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3 points, 3 for 4-5
                points, and 4 for 6 or more points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              readOnly: true
              example: 3
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality: the canonical region derived from the city
                using the fixed city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'NSW'
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name, derived from the locality using
                the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when
                the locality is not in the table.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created for this
                owner's registration date at the time this owner was created,
                otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when this owner's city already held between 40 and 49
                owners (approaching the per-city capacity limit of 50) at the
                time this owner was created, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email
                address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'EMAIL'
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, although not a hard duplicate, shares an
                existing owner's last name and postcode while carrying a
                different telephone; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner is a possible duplicate
                of (same last name and postcode, different telephone). Absent
                when 'possibleDuplicate' is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 1
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived identity key, formed as
                'normalizedTelephone + | + (email or empty) + | + householdId'.
                This single key consolidates all duplicate detection: a new owner
                is rejected with 409 only when its whole identityKey exactly
                matches an existing owner's.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '+61412345678||A1B2C3D4E5F6'
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from 'birthDate' evaluated against
                the owner's registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when
                18 to 64, and 'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Absent when no birthDate
                was supplied.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'ADULT'
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical URI path of this owner, formed as '/api/owners/'
                followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '/api/owners/1'
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM'
                when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is
                'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD),
                otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                True when any of these hold: the owner is a possible duplicate
                ('possibleDuplicate'), the owner's email domain is
                disposable-adjacent (it resembles a throwaway/disposable mailbox
                provider without being on the hard disposable blocklist, which is
                rejected outright), or the owner's city is over its soft capacity
                (the per-city capacity warning applies, i.e. the city already held
                40 or more owners). Otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is
                false; DELETE /api/owners/{id} marks the owner deleted (true) while
                retaining the record. Owners flagged deleted are ignored by the
                create endpoint's duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - deleted
            - pets

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The pet owner's optional honorific title (e.g. MR, MRS, MS, DR).
            When present it drives the derived 'salutation'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 30
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat value for
            backward compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2'
            fields are supplied they are preferred. On a response this is the
            composed, normalized address (the normalized 'addressLine1', with a
            single space and the normalized 'addressLine2' appended when present).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured postal address. Preferred
            over the flat 'address' when present; normalized like the flat address.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address.
            When present it is normalized and appended to the composed 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.

            when given.

            household); the owner is then created as a declared household member
            rather than rejected as a household duplicate, and is not flagged as

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The pet owner's optional honorific title (e.g. MR, MRS, MS, DR).
            When present it drives the derived 'salutation'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 30
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat value for
            backward compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2'
            fields are supplied they are preferred. On a response this is the
            composed, normalized address (the normalized 'addressLine1', with a
            single space and the normalized 'addressLine2' appended when present).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured postal address. Preferred
            over the flat 'address' when present; normalized like the flat address.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address.
            When present it is normalized and appended to the composed 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized by
            removing every non-digit character and must contain exactly 10 digits
            after stripping.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; validated only when present.
            When supplied it must be valid for the owner's city per the fixed
            region ranges (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city
            with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned
            when given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD). Optional;
            when present it drives the derived 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allow creating this owner even though another owner
            already has the same last name and postcode (i.e. they share a
            household); the owner is then created as a declared household member
            rather than rejected as a household duplicate, and is not flagged as
            a possible duplicate. Write-only; never returned in responses.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the stored
                names.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'Franklin, George'
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'G.F.'
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, formed as 'title lastName' when a title
                is present (e.g. 'DR Who'), or just the lastName when no title
                was supplied.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'DR Franklin'
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone (display)
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the '+' and
                country calling code, a space, then the national digits grouped
                in threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' remains
                in E.164 form.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: >-
                The version of the owner identity contract carried by this
                response. Version 2 groups the owner's identifiers (memberId,
                identityKey, householdId) under the nested 'identity' object and
                rederives each of those identifiers with the version-2 algorithm.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              readOnly: true
              example: 2
            identity:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) that
                shared the same first name and last name, compared
                case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 1
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last
                two digits of the fiscal year's starting calendar year. The
                fiscal year starts on 1 July, so a business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate on or after 1 July belongs to that calendar
                year's fiscal year and one before 1 July belongs to the previous
                calendar year's fiscal year. Absent when no registrationDate is
                available.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'FY26'
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points. Starts at 0; add 2 when an email
                address is present; add 1 when the owner has no namesakes
                (namesakeCount is 0); add 2 for a household of 3 or more; add 3
                for tenure of at least one elapsed fiscal year, measured as the
                number of fiscal-year starts (1 July) between the
                registrationDate and the current date.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 5
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, derived from
                membershipPoints: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3 points, 3 for 4-5
                points, and 4 for 6 or more points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              readOnly: true
              example: 3
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality: the canonical region derived from the city
                using the fixed city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'NSW'
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name, derived from the locality using
                the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when
                the locality is not in the table.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created for this
                owner's registration date at the time this owner was created,
                otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when this owner's city already held between 40 and 49
                owners (approaching the per-city capacity limit of 50) at the
                time this owner was created, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
